events.title: Kevin Bennett, Kelly Cork & Jacob Vincent
events.location: The Cave Inn, 47 Balaclava St., Woolloongabba, QLD, 4102
events.description: Get ready for an intimate, soul-stirring night of Australian songwriting.    This powerhouse lineup brings together three masters of musical craft.Heading the bill is Kevin Bennett, the award-winning Golden Guitar legend and driving force behind roots-rock icons Kevin Bennett & The Flood. Renowned as one of the country's most respected Indigenous singer-songwriters, Bennett masterfully blends country, blues, folk, and rock into the narrative.    Joining him is his long-time musical brother, Kelly Cork. Known for his warm stage presence and evocative, heartfelt lyrics, Cork's gift for storytelling has captivated audiences nationwide. Together, their decades-long friendship brings an unmatched warmth and musicianship to stage.    Rounding out this spectacular trio is the incredible Jacob Vincent, a rising force in the acoustic music scene, make him the perfect complement to these seasoned storytellers.Do not miss the chance to catch these three incredible artists sharing the stage    [button link="https://tickets.oztix.com.au/outlet/event/a5eff86d-1d5f-4309-b87d-7ddebeb17a03"]Tickets[/button]

events.title: Truth Seekers – Bring Your Own Conspiracy Night
events.location: The Cave Inn, 47 Balaclava St., Woolloongabba, QLD, 4102
events.description: Welcome to the first annual Truth Seekers, Meanjin (Brisbane), Australia.    Truth Seekers is the premier gathering of free thinkers, truth seekers, and true believers. This is a Bring Your Own conspiracy event - if you have a theory that is yearning for the light of day, this is your opportunity to get on stage and speak your truth.    This year we open the floor to the Brisbane community of the conspiritorially minded.    We invite you to bring your lecture, workshop, discussion, performace, etc to the conference.    Enlighten your fellow Truth Seekers between talks. Bring your dossier of truth, chemtrail charts, alien detection devices, and listening bugs. You never know when you might meet your next big client!    We will be taking submissions for preparing a schedule so if you have something you’ve prepared let us know what you need and a rough idea of the topic and format so we can allocate a space.    The entrance and ground floor of the venue is wheelchair accessible and accessible bathrooms are on the right hand side at the entrance of the ground floor.    This is an 18+ event. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.    A range of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages are available and the kitchen is serving a range of pizzas and other hot foods with vegan, vegetarian and gluten free options.    This event is taking place on the lands of the Yuggera and Turrbal peoples. Sovreignty was never ceded.    [button link="https://events.humanitix.com/truth-seekers-byo-conspiracy-night"]Tickets[/button]

events.title: Out of Abingdon Live
events.location: 47 Balaclava St, Woolloongabba, QLD, Australia, Queensland
events.description: Live at The Cave Inn    OUT of ABINGDON is a soulful acoustic duo blending stripped-back guitar, double    bass and smooth, captivating vocals. Featuring Warwick Hargreaves and Tina    Fullerton, their grooving, lounge infused sound draws on years of touring across    Australia, Europe and the UK, including jazz clubs from Edinburgh to Berlin.    Now living and touring full-time in their converted house truck, the duo channel life    on the road into their music.    OoA will be bringing their latest collection of original and interpreted tunes to their hometown    for one afternoon at The Cave Inn, Brisbane before they head outback and beyond.    [button link="https://events.humanitix.com/out-of-abingdon-live-the-cave-inn"] Tickets[/button]
